# You Are the Hero

A Skill Harbor house build: a solo adventure campaign in chat, where you are the hero. Your assistant invents an original world just for your campaign, with peoples, places, and creatures found in no existing work, and creates your character with you in at most three questions: a name, two or three short traits, and one simple resource called Breath, counted from 0 to 5. The campaign runs three to six chapters, each of six to ten scenes. At every scene you get a short situation, two to four choices as buttons, and a standing invitation to write any action of your own instead.

What makes this game different is that nothing is improvised. Before the first scene of a chapter is shown, the whole chapter already exists, written and timestamped inside your campaign state file: every scene text, every choice, and the exact consequence that will apply if you pick it, effects on inventory, flags, and Breath included. A coherence check over branches, conditions, and established facts must pass before play begins. When you choose, you receive the consequence written for that choice, followed by a one-line summary of its mechanical effects. Consequences can also land later: a promise, a grudge, or a debt becomes a flag with a named future scene where it comes due, and the text prepared for that moment is the text you get.
